media.alt_text: Turquoise Fairy Pools waterfall cascading over rocks on the Isle of Skye, Scotland

caption.body:
The Fairy Pools on the Isle of Skye — about 2.5km round trip from the car park and one of the best walks I did in Scotland.

Go early if you can. It gets busy by mid-morning, and the midges are less aggressive before the crowds arrive.

Skye was also better for GF dining than I expected — 11 restaurants tested in Portree, three of them scoring 5/5 on my GF safety scale. More on the site.
